title: Metadata Settings
description: Configure how metadata is retrieved, stored, and matched for your books, including provider settings and field preferences.

autoDownload.warning: When enabled, metadata will be automatically retrieved from your configured sources whenever new files are added to the Bookdrop folder. Please note that processing a large number of files simultaneously may increase the time required for metadata fetching.
autoDownload.enableLabel: Enable automatic metadata download for Bookdrop imports

isbnDiscovery.sectionDesc: Scan the first and last pages of each book for a checksum-valid ISBN (copyright page or back cover), then fetch metadata using that ISBN as ground truth. Designed to fill large libraries with minimal manual review.
isbnDiscovery.onBookdropLabel: Run ISBN discovery on Bookdrop imports
isbnDiscovery.onLibraryScanLabel: Run ISBN discovery during library scans (off by default — heavy)
isbnDiscovery.ocrHint: Soft-fails if the AI Search sidecar is unavailable. Text-extractable formats still work.
isbnDiscovery.reviewBeforeApplyLabel: Require review before applying ISBN-verified fetches
isbnDiscovery.reviewBeforeApplyHint: Leave off to auto-apply when ISBN is verified. Ambiguous or failed discoveries still go to review. Does not change the global metadata refresh review default.
isbnDiscovery.writeBackLabel: Write ISBN-fetched metadata to original files
isbnDiscovery.writeBackHint: Default off. When on, also sets a searchable “written to file” flag. Still requires format write-back to be enabled in Persistence settings.
isbnDiscovery.maxPagesLabel: Max pages to scan (front and back)
isbnDiscovery.maxPagesHint: Scans the first N pages, then the last N pages (including the back cover) if no ISBN is found up front.

persistence.sectionDesc: Configure how metadata is written to original files and how files are moved or renamed when metadata changes.
persistence.networkWarning: These features directly modify and move book files on disk (including rewriting metadata and renaming files). If your library is stored on a NAS, NFS share, SMB/CIFS mount, or other network-attached storage, set DISK_TYPE=NETWORK in your environment to safely disable automatic file rewrite and reorganization features. Database metadata will still work normally, and manual sidecar backup remains available.
persistence.networkModeDesc: This instance is configured for network storage (DISK_TYPE=NETWORK). Automatic file rewrite and reorganization features are disabled. Metadata stays in the database unless you explicitly run a manual sidecar backup.
persistence.unsupportedNote: Writing metadata is not supported for FB2, AZW3, and MOBI formats.
persistence.writeEpubDesc: Write metadata directly into EPUB files when editing book information.
persistence.writeCbxDesc: Write metadata directly into CBX files when editing book information.
persistence.writePdfDesc: Write metadata directly into PDF files when editing book information.
persistence.writePdfNote: PDFs do not support embedded covers. Only Title, Authors, Publisher, Categories, Description, Language, and Published Date can be updated.
persistence.writeAudiobookDesc: Write metadata directly into audiobook files (M4B, M4A, MP3, etc.) when editing book information.
persistence.writeAudiobookNote: Supports title, authors, narrator, description, publisher, categories, series, language, and cover art. For folder-based audiobooks, cover is saved as cover.jpg in the folder.
persistence.maxFileSizeTooltip: Only files up to this size will be updated. Larger files are ignored.
persistence.autoMoveDesc: Automatically move and rename files according to their library's naming pattern when metadata is updated.
persistence.sidecarDesc: Create external .metadata.json files alongside your books for portable metadata storage and backup.
persistence.enableSidecarDesc: Enable sidecar JSON metadata files. When enabled, metadata can be written to BookName.metadata.json files alongside your books.
persistence.writeOnUpdateDesc: Automatically update the sidecar JSON file whenever book metadata is edited.
persistence.writeOnScanDesc: Create sidecar JSON files when books are first added to the library during scanning.
persistence.includeCoverDesc: Also save the cover image as BookName.cover.jpg alongside the sidecar JSON file.
persistence.sidecarBackupDesc: Manually create or refresh sidecar JSON backup files for a selected library, even when automatic sidecar writing is disabled or DISK_TYPE is set to NETWORK.
persistence.sidecarBackupHint: This is a manual backup action only. It does not turn on automatic sidecar writes during scans or metadata edits, and rerunning it updates previous backup sidecars in place.
persistence.sidecarBackupNoLibraries: Create a library first to use sidecar backup.
persistence.sidecarBackupSuccess: Backed up sidecar files for {{count}} books in the selected library.
persistence.sidecarBackupSuccessWithPruned: Backed up sidecar files for {{count}} books and cleaned up {{pruned}} orphaned records in the selected library.
persistence.sidecarBackupPartial: Backed up sidecar files for {{count}} books, but {{failed}} of {{attempted}} writes failed. First error: {{error}}
persistence.sidecarBackupFailureDetail: No sidecar files were backed up. {{failed}} of {{attempted}} writes failed. First error: {{error}}
persistence.sidecarBackupUnknownError: No detailed filesystem error was returned.
persistence.sidecarBackupError: Failed to back up sidecar files for the selected library.
persistence.flushDesc: Manually write all current database metadata back to the original book files on disk. Use this to sync metadata after switching from NETWORK to LOCAL storage mode, or to populate files that were never written.
persistence.flushHint: This writes metadata for all books where the corresponding file format write option (EPUB, PDF, CBX, Audiobook) is enabled above. Books whose format is not enabled, or books with no supported writer, will be skipped.
persistence.flushStarted: Metadata flush task started. Monitor progress in Task Management.
persistence.flushError: Failed to start metadata flush task.

providers.sectionDesc: Configure which online sources to use for fetching book metadata. Enable providers and set up their API tokens or cookies to access richer book information.
providers.saveError: Failed to save metadata provider settings.
providers.cookieDesc: Providing your Amazon session cookie allows the app to access richer book metadata and bypass rate limits.
providers.googleApiDesc: Providing a Google Books API key increases rate limits and improves reliability.
providers.amazonSetupTitle: How to set up Amazon cookies
providers.amazonStep1: Go to your Amazon website (e.g. amazon.com) in this browser and sign in to your account.
providers.amazonStep2: Drag the bookmark below onto your bookmarks bar — you only need to do this once:
providers.amazonStep3: While on any Amazon page, click the Get Amazon Cookies bookmark.
providers.amazonStep4: Return to this page and click Paste Cookies — the field will fill in automatically.
providers.amazonStep5: Click Save Configurations. Amazon cookies expire periodically — repeat these steps if Amazon stops returning results.
providers.amazonPasteError: Could not read clipboard. Please paste manually into the field below.

publicReviews.sectionDesc: Configure automatic downloading of user reviews from external platforms. Reviews can be fetched from Amazon, Goodreads, and Hardcover for offline access.
publicReviews.autoDownloadDesc: Automatically fetch reviews when you open a book's details page. When disabled, reviews will only be downloaded manually or during metadata refresh.
publicReviews.reviewSourcesDesc: Configure which platforms to download reviews from and set limits for each source.
publicReviews.noProviders: No review sources available. Please ensure metadata providers are configured in the Provider Settings section above.

matchWeights.sectionDesc: Configure how important each metadata field is when computing match scores. Higher weights make fields more influential in determining the overall match quality.
matchWeights.recalculateDesc: Recomputes match scores for all books based on the latest weights.
matchWeights.recalcSuccess: All book match scores were recalculated successfully.

fieldSelector.sectionTitle: Enabled Fields in Metadata Editor & Picker
fieldSelector.sectionDesc: Select which metadata fields to display when editing book information or picking metadata from providers. Disabled fields will be hidden from the interface.
